reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: DNN potentials are known to capture complex many-body interactions better than EAM, and training on high-T AIMD data directly addresses the configurational diversity of the liquid, making the predicted improvement in phase-space overlap and reduction in TI mismatch plausible.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive: a direct comparison of TI mismatch between DNN and EAM references against an AIMD benchmark, with a specific quantitative falsification criterion (≥30% reduction), though the practical feasibility of the AIMD benchmark at these temperatures is challenging.
reasons.usefulness: This is highly useful for the specific research question, as it proposes a concrete, modern methodological intervention (active-learned DNN) with a defined benchmark and falsification test, directly addressing the core issue of reference-target overlap in high-temperature HEA liquids.
